description: This file defines a static helper class `CorrelationIdGenerator` within the `Orleans.Networking.Shared` namespace. The class provides methods to generate unique correlation IDs based on a timestamp and a counter, encoded in a custom Base32 scheme. It maintains an internal last ID state that is incremented atomically to ensure thread-safe ID generation.

classes.name: CorrelationIdGenerator
classes.description: A static class responsible for generating unique correlation IDs using an internal counter and timestamp.

methods.name: GetNextId
methods.description: Generates and returns the next unique correlation ID as a string.

methods.name: GenerateId
methods.description: Creates a 13-character string ID from a long integer using a custom Base32 encoding scheme.
